errors.description: Model incorrectly counted the number of cubes with exactly 1 exposed face based on a false assumption of a full 3×3×3 structure, leading to an answer of 6 instead of 0.

analysis_result.analysis: The model fundamentally misperceived the structure, assuming a full 3×3×3 cube when the actual structure was a 3×3×2 grid with 10 cubes removed (leaving 8). This led to a cascade of errors: it applied standard 3×3×3 face-exposure logic (which yields 6 face-center cubes with 1 exposed face) to a structure that had no such cubes. The correct analysis, based on the actual remaining 8 cubes, shows that none have exactly 1 face exposed — all have 2 or more. The model’s reasoning is internally consistent but built on a false perceptual foundation.
